populationAccounting: Native H2 stays separate from auxiliary scenario review and future acceptance-test specifications

proposedConsumerOutcomes.termination: Keep deterministic observation; probe remains evaluation only
proposedConsumerOutcomes.gateAdvice: Defer until genuine prospective operator evidence
proposedConsumerOutcomes.causeSummary: Advisory inference with evidence and uncertainty; replacing Autopsy deferred pending references
proposedConsumerOutcomes.knowledgeSupport: No assessment changes evaluateSupport or canonical acceptance
proposedConsumerOutcomes.enforcingEscalation: Develop only after consumer-specific validation and rollout controls

limits.unknownCost: Report unknown cost; bound invocation count and runtime; do not present estimate as enforced budget

purpose: Decide how to develop and use the Decision Ledger without indefinite exploratory shadow collection

allowedChanges: owned pipeline definitions and instances through authenticated running app

designRules: Observations, assessments, accepted knowledge and policy decisions are distinct records
Termination remains an authoritative deterministic observation
Subject-authored prose cannot grant permissions or make knowledge canonical
Consumers bind question/projection/provider/policy versions and exact scope/state/attempt
Replay reads stored results; reevaluation creates a separate recorded call
H1 requires genuine blinded operator actions; automated actions are not human references
Current 200-answer calibration display threshold is not proof of policy safety

closure.claims: Residual correctness, human gate safety and exact-snapshot stability stay unproven without appropriate references/capabilities
closure.coverage: Include genuinely recorded deadlines if existing live capability permits; never infer class from scenario intention
closure.integrity: Zero unexplained journal/ledger gaps or snapshot hash mismatches in relied-on evidence
closure.accounting: Each source run and selected question explicitly assessed, not-selected, excluded, pending, expired or abandoned

stages: Freeze live baseline and pre-register closure criteria
Pause repetitive owned feeder after capturing its definition; add 16 varied isolated source runs with genuine deadline cases first
Allow maturity and FIFO collector drain; account for every run and selected question
Independent review of exact retained inputs and assessments
Design ledger and pipeline consumers with sequenced backlog and acceptance tests
Final evidence reconciliation; stop exploratory feeder and write accept/defer/reject decision
